Official Bio

Band Biography

Born on the Banks of Possum Creek

Possum Creek Pickers are an authentic bluegrass and acoustic band rooted in the scenic river valleys of Chattanooga, Tennessee. The band’s origin is as genuine as their sound: long before playing festivals and listening rooms, the members started out as close friends jamming on the tranquil banks of Possum Creek in Hamilton County, where their name was born.

Driven by a shared love for timeless Appalachian acoustics, high-energy flatpicking, and soulful vocal arrangements, Possum Creek Pickers deliver a rich performance that bridges traditional bluegrass roots with lively contemporary acoustic pickin'.

Whether performing intimate acoustic sets or high-energy mainstage festival slots, Possum Creek Pickers captivate audiences with fast-tempo instrumental breakdowns, high lonesome mandolin leads, and three-part vocal harmonies that echo the heart of East Tennessee.

Venue & Sound Engineers

Stage Plot & Technical Rider

Quick reference line-up inputs for venue sound technicians.

Inputs & Vocal Channels

  • CH 1
    Elliott Brown — Lead Vocal

    Standard Vocal Mic (Shure SM58 or equivalent)

  • CH 2
    Elliott Brown — Acoustic Guitar

    Active DI Box or Instrument Mic

  • CH 3
    Micah Courey — Mandolin & Backup Vocal

    Instrument DI / Condenser Mic + Vocal Mic

  • CH 4
    Kevin Taylor — Upright Bass & Backup Vocal

    Bass Pickup DI / Mic + Vocal Mic

Stage Setup & Requirements

Power: 1x standard 120V AC outlet on stage.

Monitors: 2 to 3 monitor mixes (Center vocal, Left mandolin, Right bass).

Setup Time: 15–20 minute soundcheck requirement.

Acoustic Environment: Suitable for both amplified PA stages and natural unamplified room acoustics.
